name: rke-7159e9ad-blind23-ots
instr:
# RKE: wrong images, failed credential generation and unreadable saved snapshots — diagnosing without a test suite

Running this build through a normal day, almost everything I try reports something odd, and the oddities have nothing to do with each other. The repository has received 23 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I could pin down from the outside, written up by what I was doing at the time.

Standing an installation back up from a saved snapshot picks the wrong image to do it with. With the datastore image at v3.5.7, and again at v3.5.8, the image chosen for the restoring run no longer agrees with the one chosen for taking the backup, which is what it used to be; at v3.5.6, and for an image published under a private namespace, the answer still comes back as the plain image I handed in. Two more edits feed the same wrong answer. The lookup of the default helper image reports a failure on input it used to resolve without complaint, and the step that reads the release information bundled into the binary reaches for the wrong source, so with no external location configured it tries to fetch from an empty address and comes back empty-handed rather than reading the copy shipped inside.
